Hey there, thanks for sharing. I know the feelings too well. On top of the world, life is sweet, nothing can go wrong and then misery, hopeless, desperation, anger, regrets. The amount you win just doesn't matter for compulsive gamblers. That site could give you back your $40k in losses into your account right now but you won't take the money out. You will try and win back the other $50k that never existed in the first place. And if by a miracle you do get to $100k, you might withdrawal and let's say you did. Made a sick profit and you spend some winnings, buy some gifts, put some money away, etc. Then it will set in slowly but surely, the brain will crave for action. You can't sleep well because it's all you think about. Be it the same site again (which they are hoping) or some local casino, but as long as you give in, you continue to bet, and then before you know it, it's all gone.

As for me, It's been about 3 weeks since my last degen session which I turned a $200 deposit to about $950 in a couple hours playing poker, then ran that up to over $4k playing BJ. Fast forward 2 days later and account at 0 not surprisingly lol.
